name: switch-aws-profile
description: Switch AWS profile in plain language with the switch-profile CLI: list and switch AWS accounts, AWS SSO logins, import IAM Identity Center portals, create, rename and remove profiles.

node.description: Node.js with npx, which fetches and runs switch-profile. The CLI refuses to start below 20.12.0

install.linux: curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_lts.x | sudo -E bash - && sudo apt-get install -y nodejs

aws.description: AWS CLI v2, which does every login and identity check. 2.22+ for device codes, 2.32+ for console sign-in
